## Checklist

`quality-gate.yml` already ran the full gate on this PR. That file is the list; copying it here only
creates a second one to keep in step, and the copy is what goes stale. Nothing the gate decides is
repeated below — what follows is the part it cannot decide.

- [ ] New or changed routes declare their error responses via `errorResponses(...)` (AGENTS.md §C Rule 13)
- [ ] New service logic has unit tests with a local `__tests__/helpers.ts` mock builder (AGENTS.md §E Rule 19)
- [ ] A new state-mutating route declares an auth guard
- [ ] Async work goes through a queue rather than a direct call on the request path
- [ ] `.env.<target>.example` updated if a new env var was added, and `src/env.ts`'s schema matches

### If this PR touches `src/db/schema/`

Delete this block if the schema did not move.

- [ ] Migration read by hand, not only generated — drift and index coverage are checked in CI,
      but a rename autogenerated as drop-then-add passes both and loses the column's data
- [ ] Migration **applied** to the dev database. CI catches a schema change with no migration; it
      cannot catch a migration nobody ran, and every branch querying the new table then fails
      against dev while looking healthy in review.
- [ ] Downgrade path either works or the migration says in a comment why it is one-way

### If this PR touches queries (AGENTS.md §H)

Delete this block if it added no database access.

- [ ] Every list query has an explicit `.limit()` and the endpoint is paginated (Rule 29)
- [ ] Columns are selected explicitly, not a bare `select()` on a wide table (Rule 30)
- [ ] No query runs inside a loop — batched via `inArray()`, a join, or RQB `with:` (Rule 31)
- [ ] Every filtered/sorted/joined column is indexed, committed here; FK columns always (Rule 32)
- [ ] Transactions contain DB work only — no HTTP, Redis, or queue calls (Rule 35)
